IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA  CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS No.15262 of 2024  Arising Out of PS. Case No.-298 Year-2020 Thana- SIWAN MUFFASIL Distr  ======================================================

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ram Babu Bhagat S/O Late Bhagelu Bhagat R/O Village- Mura Gopalganj  Aghola, P.S- Dhanauti O.P., Distt.- Siwan.

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Md. Soban Asghar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Md. Ataur Rahman, APP

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA SHEKHAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 14-03-2024 Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State.

2. The accused/petitioner is named in F.I.R. and apprehending his arrest in connection with Siwan Muffasil (Dhanauti O.P.) P.S. Case No. 298/2020 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 354, 354(B), 504, 509, 376, 511 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The allegation against petitioner is to made an attempt for rape upon informant/victim and also to outrage her modesty along with other co-accused persons, where occurrence is alleged to be arise out of land dispute, Patna High Court CR.
descriptions of which is available in the F.I.R. itself.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that petitioner implicated with present case only being relative of main co-accused Ram Bhajan Bhagat, who has already granted anticipatory bail by one of the learned co-ordinate Bench of this Court through Cr. Misc. No. 604 of 2023 dated 07.04.2023 against whom, the specific allegation regarding attempt of rape is available as per F.I.R.
It is submitted that the allegation is in the background of the land dispute.
It is submitted that the allegation against the petitioner is limited to torn nighty during the course of occurrence which might possible out of scuffling.
The petitioner is a man of clean antecedent.

sentences.text: Learned APP appearing for the State opposes the prayer of bail.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances and by taking note of fact as thrust of allegation regarding attempt for rape is available against co- accused Ram Babu Bhagat, who has already granted anticipatory bail by learned co-ordinate Bench of this Court, Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.15262 of 2024(2) dt.14-03-2024 as a matter of parity and considering the nature of allegation as alleged in the F.I.R., the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest or surrender before learned trial court within a period of four weeks, is directed to be released on bail furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned A.C.J.M.-Ist, Siwan/concerned Court, where the case is pending in connection with Siwan Muffasil (Dhanauti O.P.) P.S. Case No. 298 of 2020, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) sadique/-
